conclusion: A labelled IPv4 /32 and one peer host route can support an independent native key-only SSH endpoint while eth0 is outside br0. Move only these owned objects to br0 after ASUS enslaves eth0; do not change bridge membership. This requires runtime identity, master, address, ARP/routing and filtering checks and a later focused test. It is not physical availability evidence.

source_evidence.finding: IFA_F_SECONDARY is recalculated; a different-subnet /32 is not secondary. Scope ordering can place it before the normal global address. Waiting for an existing normal address does not prevent this. Explicit IFA_LABEL is retained, exported in netlink dumps and used by SIOCGIFADDR label matching.
Actual native glibc2.44 source assigns IFA_LABEL to ifa_name, using link name only when no label was supplied.

Pinned asuswrt6 9b25e55ca5c56a6f01d6a56264c0f6c47459ada0 getifaddr returns the first matching getifaddrs address; exact ifa_name comparison excludes br0:lr from getifaddr(br0). This source relationship is not an execution test of every vendor consumer.
Normal port22 config generation requires exact normal LAN ifa_name and requested IPv4; labelled rescue addresses are excluded.
LAN acceptance requires exact br0, enrolled normal IPv4 and LAN_PORT; rescue labels/2223 do not satisfy the health or SSH ACK gate.
Local delivery through a bridge changes skb->dev to br0; VLAN, bridge-state and netfilter gates remain. A labelled address on eth0 alone is not an independent receive path once enslaved.
Bridge uses the lower-device RX handler. Do not create macvlan on eth0 or otherwise compete for that handler.
Strict reverse-path filtering requires a reverse route through the receiving device. Move the peer host route with the rescue address; never solve this by changing rp_filter.
A local-destination route does not alone bypass source validation. Do not rely on weak-host delivery to avoid interface migration.

arp_ignore1 is compatible when the address lives on the incoming interface. arp_ignore2 requires same-subnet sender and conflicts with distinct /32 peers; ignore8 suppresses replies. arp_filter checks the reply route's device. Future helper must inspect, not modify these policies.
Normal routed firewall startup skips non-routing modes; routed defaults otherwise drop INPUT. This is not a proof that candidate INPUT/bridge filtering permits rescue.
is_routing_enabled means ROUTER or HOTSPOT, not current AP mode3.

design.rescue_socket: fixed rescue IPv4, no BindToDevice, key-only native existing host key/account/PAM, AllowUsers MastermixStudios@169.254.190.51
design.normal_lan_address_gate: Require normal br0 IPv4 before installing br0:lr; labels remain mandatory regardless of ordering.
design.router_link_identity: eth0 exact MAC02:00:00:f0:00:01; ifindex discovered and revalidated each operation, not permanently pinned to stock20; target master only none or exact br0.
design.controller_link_identity: br-lan exact MAC02:00:00:f0:00:02; current ifindex10 is observation only.
design.preserve: All existing addresses/routes including ASUS169.254.0.2 deveth.ai-10, DHCP, NVRAM, bridge/VLAN, sysctls, firewall and default routes.
design.helper_recommendation: Small bounded native netlink helper after contract review. One-shot ip commands are simpler for manual provisioning but a shell monitor complicates exact multipart-message identity, foreign state rejection and cleanup. No helper built or implemented here.

limits: No network, device mutation, compilation, syntax check, namespace fixture or runtime test performed by this audit.
Read-only inventories are stock/controller snapshots, not proof of the next native candidate's state or end-to-end L2 reachability.
No route/address multi-object atomicity: interface transition may interrupt existing SSH and must allow a new connection.
Link state, ASUS bridge STP/learning/disabled state, VLAN/filter rules, offload behavior and controller route policy may still prevent access.
No Ethernet MAC authentication claim; key authentication remains required. Address/MAC source pins are enrolment checks only.
Rescue requires native systemd/OpenSSH/account/PAM and existing keys; it cannot repair a dead kernel or satisfy trial acceptance.
